description: This file contains a custom WebApplicationFactory class for testing purposes in an ASP.NET Core application. It sets up an in-memory database environment for testing by overriding CreateHost to configure service dependencies, primarily replacing real database contexts with in-memory versions.

classes.name: TestApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for functional testing that configures the test server environment with in-memory databases for CatalogContext and AppIdentityDbContext, replacing the default database configurations.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the environment to 'Development' and replaces certain database context configurations with in-memory database options for testing.
